title: Maa Pukaare Lout Aao
body:
Maa pukare lot aawo
(Haaye Ali Asghar) x8
<<MINI>>
(Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Jeena mushkil mera) x2 Ay maa ke dulhaare asghar
<<MINI>>
(Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu na jana kya khabar thi gar meri jaan maa hu
Bhulna paawungi tujhko zindagi bhar chaahu(n)
(Dekhle haal mera) x2 Ay maa ke sahaare asghar
<<MINI>>
(Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Apne haatho(n) se sajaaya, tujhko dulhe ki tarha
Meri aahosh hai veera(n), dekh jhule ki tarha
(Sunlo madar ki sada) x2 Ay jaan se pyaare asghar
<<MINI>>
(Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu gaya jab se hai beta, tere bin jee na saku
Hai kasam mujhko meri jaa(n), ab na saaye mei rahu
(Maa ko chehra to dikha) x2 Maa sadqa utaare asghar
<<MINI>>
(Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa ki jageer hai bas kya, haay shaluka tera
Teri masoom adaaey, wo machalna tera
(teri maa tujhpe fida) x2 Awaaz sunade asghar
<<MINI>>
(Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekho roti hai Sakina sunke ye gham ka sukhan
Khun mei tar mere asghar, ko mila kaisa kafan
(Akhri eik diya) x2 Roro ke jalaaye asghar
<<MINI>>
(Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Bole asghar mei hu(n) kamsin, par hu ghazi sa jari
Mujhme zahra ki mehek hai, mei bhi hu(n) khoon-e-ali
(Teri godi ka sila) x2 Maqtal mei dikhaaye asghar
<<MINI>>
(Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri saanso mei meri maa, teri khushbu hai rachi Aur nigaaho mei hai meri, teri mamta hai shabi
(Tere pehlu ke bina) x2 Ab cheyn na paaye asghar
<<MINI>>
(Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere "Yawar" ki dua hai, mere maula Asghar
Aisi awlaad ata kar, jo ho teri nokar
(Sunle maao(n) ki dua) x2 Godo ko sajaade asghar
<<MINI>>
Maa pukare lot aawo, mere pyaare asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
(Haaye ali asghar) x2
